item.title: 1.19.40 (Beta)
item.description:
New

Customizable Bulk Card Generation

We’ve added new controls for bulk-generating cards from PDFs, YouTube videos, and webpages:

  • Section Selection: Select which sections or subsections you want to generate from.

  • Level of Detail: Choose from “High level summary”, “Important ideas”, or “Exhaustive Detail”.

  • Model: Pre-select your AI model and preview the amount of AI credits that will be used.

Sections that you’ve already generated content for will be tracked and shown, to help you avoid generating duplicate cards.


Improvements & Bugs

  • Table Flashcards: Improved scrolling in table cards, highlighted currently-tested column/row, and ensured flashcard insights remain in view.

  • Advanced Tables: Fixed cell format and style not applying in compact view.

  • Advanced Tables: Fixed inability to apply NOT expression in table filters.

  • Advanced Tables: Fixed inability to delete multi-line flashcard arrow in table cells.

  • Advanced Tables: Fixed tables getting out of order when pasted from ChatGPT.

  • All Notes Page: Fixed global search preview not closing when clicking on results.

  • Advanced Tables: Improved autofill functionality.

  • Advanced Tables: Improved bulk reorder by allowing drag to reorder multiple selected rows in bulk edit mode.

  • Editor: Changed LaTeX control sequences to darker orange instead of bright red.

  • MCAT: Improved QBank highlight colors in dark mode.

  • Editor: Fixed copying and pasting rems from hide-bullets documents incorrectly showing bullets.

  • Editor: Fixed fast pressing enter on large documents creating new rem in stale position.

  • Editor: Fixed inability to insert rem as child.

  • Editor: Fixed MacOS text replacement issue with Chromium.

  • Editor: Fixed search not working on void links.

  • Editor: Fixed type children portal view not appearing on daily docs.

  • Flashcards: Fixed confusing popup when changing daily target.

  • Flashcards: Fixed image occlusion not working in rem reference preview.

  • Flashcards: Fixed inconsistent behavior when opening YouTube Annotator linked as source.

  • Flashcards: Fixed queue preview not working for YouTube annotations.

  • Mobile: Fixed breadcrumbs in mobile preview popup.

  • Mobile: Fixed iOS badge number not refreshing if app not opened.

  • Mobile: Fixed settings invite option hidden on iOS web.

  • PDF Viewer: Fixed AI summary not being generated for PDFs.

  • PDF Viewer: Fixed auto-rename workflow to skip PDF renaming if user has edited the name.

  • PDF Viewer: Fixed drawing canvas and toolbar functionality.

  • PDF Viewer: Fixed last rem not scrolling into view on edit or caret change.

  • PDF Viewer: Fixed recording and uploading audio jumping to parent document when PDF is open.

  • Simple Tables: Fixed alignment of rem bullets.

  • Simple Tables: Fixed image, audio, and video embed input being shrunk.

  • Simple Tables: Fixed removal of entire table when all rows are selected and removed.

  • Simple Tables: Fixed sorting by checkbox not working properly with checked options always at top.

  • YouTube Annotator: Fixed inability to enable non-single character keyboard shortcuts in inline code.

  • YouTube Annotator: Fixed some transcripts not loading.

  • YouTube Annotator: Fixed thumbnail showing waiting/failed placeholder forever in upload preview.

  • AI Tools: Fixed "Card Types" section incorrectly showing in magic copy-paste config when "Multiple-Choice Quiz" is selected.

  • Editor: Fixed error when attempting to paste images in data URI scheme without access to actual image.

  • Editor: Fixed external image URL pasting twice.

  • Editor: Fixed importing user knowledge base on Windows leading to crashes.

  • Editor: Fixed paste menu to include "keep as reference" as default.

  • MCAT: Pushed QBank back for intro chapters.

item.title: 1.19.39 (Beta)
item.description:
New

  • Mobile Widgets
    Our new mobile widgets proudly display your streak and warn you if you haven’t done your daily cards yet.


  • Disable Specific AI Features
    Don’t want to use a specific AI feature? You can now disable individual AI features from your settings in “AI > AI Feature Usage > Toggle the checkboxes”.

Improvements

  • Flashcards: Changed "Auto-Pause Frequency" to a global setting for better consistency.

  • Flashcards: Improved card previews on mobile devices for better readability.

Bugs

  • Advanced Tables: Fixed table row "Open" button overlapping with text on mobile devices.

  • Editor: Fixed copied links becoming "undefined" in some cases.

  • Editor: Fixed /tc command not removing "/tc" text when used while zoomed into a rem.

  • Editor: Fixed aliases not appearing after adding them.

  • Editor: Fixed "Done Editing" button being unresponsive on mobile.

  • Editor: Fixed image download retrying too many times.

  • Search: Fixed web links in search option descriptions and disabled feature for new users.

  • YouTube Annotator: Disabled playback speed control buttons on mobile for better user experience.

  • YouTube Annotator: Fixed transcript parsing issues and permanent transcript failures after temporary errors.

item.title: 1.19.37 (Beta)
item.description:
New

  • Desktop App: Added "Paste without formatting" and "Paste all in one rem" to the right-click menu.

Bugs & Improvements

  • Editor: Improved background image upload functionality.

  • Card Table: Renamed "Go back" button for better clarity.

  • Editor: Expanded hit target for Rem options menu trigger.

  • Editor: Various small performance optimizations.

  • MCAT: Adjusted design of the "Study Mode" QBank.

  • PDF Viewer: Optimized PDF selection for better performance.

  • Queue: Now scrolls table cell popup into view when pressing edit.

  • Desktop App: Fixed issue where audio recordings couldn't be played on desktop but worked in the web app.

  • Editor: Added "[Press Tab]" hint at the end of tab-completion continuations.

  • Editor: Fixed "delete card" action misplacing cursor in the editor.

  • Flashcards: Fixed issue where choosing "Practice All" from the card table did not save progress if leaving the queue partway through.

  • Flashcards: Fixed Text-to-Speech spoiling the answers of multiple-choice cards.

  • iOS App: Fixed dark mode iOS icon issue where OS provides background.

  • PDF Viewer: Fixed UI glitch in PDF Preview 'Show Source' on iPad Air 2024.

  • Simple Tables: Fixed document icon disappearing on primary column cells in full height mode.

item.title: 1.19.36 (Beta)
item.description:
New Features

  • You can now export export notes to Microsoft Word!

Bug Fixes

  • AI Tools: Fixed Ask AI and magic copy-paste popup not displaying with very large text selections.

  • Documents: Improved navigation by directly zooming into sidebar rem from table open button.

  • Editor: Improved text formatting by preventing text and background colors from being saved when pasting.

  • Documents: Fixed issue where direct document children of explicit folders couldn't be reordered in the editable tree.

  • Editor: Fixed issue where using /tc command in document title doesn't remove the "/tc" text.

  • Simple Tables: Fixed back of card placeholder appearing on readonly mode empty table cells.

  • Simple Tables: Fixed drop indicator appearing on simple table header row and added toast notification instead.

  • Simple Tables: Fixed simple table settings not appearing when nested inside another portal.

item.title: 1.19.35 (Beta)
item.description:
Performance

  • We’ve fixed a major editor performance regression that was introduced in 1.19.34. We’re expanding our performance-testing test suite even further to prevent future re-occurrences. Apologies!

  • Sneak peak: We also have a number of exciting major performance improvements coming in the following weeks to the editor, mobile, and more. We’ll be inviting alpha testers to test these new systems soon.
    We're fully focused on performance, polish, and bugs this summer. More coming soon!

New Features

  • iOS App: Added dark & tinted icons.

Bugs

  • Editor: Fixed freeze caused by recursive table cell.

  • Editor: Improved usability by making the "outdent" message disappear when pressing Esc.

  • Editor: Made typing in the link popup easier.

  • Editor: Removed legacy rich text editor anchor tag color.

  • Localization: Updated numerous translations.

  • Audio: Fixed greyed-out play button for audio files in the desktop app.

  • Knowledge Base: Fixed issue preventing users from switching knowledge bases on Android.

  • MCAT: Fixed graph display issue that was causing squished appearance.

  • Mobile: Fixed issue on iOS where clicking the audio play button in queue revealed the answer.

  • PDF Viewer: Resolved error showing "chapter not found" for carbohydrates content.

  • Settings: Fixed display of "Hide due cards badge" setting on Android and Windows.

  • Login: Fixed issue when trying to add Google account while switching emails.

  • Sharing: Fixed problem with resharing and unsharing shared documents.

item.title: 1.19.33 (Beta)
item.description:
Bugfixes

  • Advanced Tables: Fixed sticky header misalignments when nested tables are present.

  • Advanced Tables: Fixed links not updating titles correctly in table cells.

  • Editor: Fixed an issue where copying multiple choice flashcards between knowledge bases didn't retain formatting.

  • Editor: Improved pasting options to display "Image" instead of "Text" when pasting images.

  • Search Portals: Fixed search portal not finding any results for card queries.

  • Knowledge Bases: Fixed custom KB images not appearing in the desktop app.

  • YouTube Annotator: Fixed breadcrumbs not immediately updating after moving content.

Bugfixes

  • Flashcards: Fixed multiline card hints not showing up in queue.

  • Editor: Fixed text color shortcuts changing header sizes.

  • Editor: Added a tooltip for the Merge button.

Bugs & Improvements

  • Editor: Improved heading level selection visibility in the 6-dot button menu.

  • Editor: Fixed pasting links to Rems now adds a Rem reference instead.

  • Flashcards: Improved handling of unbound letter keys to prevent accidental card flipping.

  • PDF Viewer: Removed "original headers only" option for non-PDF documents.

  • Record Tab: Cleaned up record tab styling.

  • Alias: Fixed hidden "Property type" and "Flashcard configuration" fields for Aliases.

  • Audio: Fixed audio recording permissions issue in the Windows desktop app.

  • Audio: Fixed audio recording stopping appropriately when errors occur.

  • Desktop App: Fixed inability to delete Local Database Cache using Windows desktop app.

  • Flashcards: Fixed scrolling issues in flashcard preview popup.

  • iOS: Fixed stability issues when switching between apps.

  • MCAT: Fixed a/b/c/d shortcuts not working properly in Qbank.

  • PDF Viewer: Fixed PDF name change menu appearing cut off with only 1-2 characters visible.

  • PDF Viewer: Fixed empty toast flashing when opening a PDF source.

  • Simple Tables: Fixed issue with removing or deleting Embed Website from a Simple Table.

  • Template Editor: Fixed non-working buttons on mobile and text overlap issues.

  • Type Answer: Fixed caret movement issues inside the Type answer field after editing a card.

  • Flashcards: Fixed issue where pressing Enter at the beginning of a multi-line card's front moves incorrectly.

New Features

Lecture/Meeting Audio Recording

You can now record audio and associate it with a document. Perfect for lectures, meetings, brainstorming sessions, etc!

1. Click "Add Source” > “Record” to start a recording

2. An audio “play back” bar will appear at the top of your document.

Local Backups Control

On the desktop app, you can now control the storage duration of local backups. Go to “Settings” > “Backups” > “Local Backups” to edit:

  • Local backup retention time

  • Maximum total local backup size (GB)

Local backups are now compressed automatically, reducing storage space.

Improvements

  • MCAT: Added an “interleave sections” option for the MCAT scheduler.

  • MCAT: Added ability to reset MCAT question banks.

  • Custom CSS: Added CSS hooks for the new link format.

Bugs

  • Editor: Fixed highlighting issue where trying to highlight entire Rems from the menu only highlights the text, not the Rem.

  • Flashcards: Fixed "Use AI Features" setting not being individually searchable in settings.

  • UI: Fixed navbar spacing issues on tablet-sized screens on the homepage.

  • AI Tools: Fixed issue where pressing copy in the AI Tutor wasn't correctly pasting tables.

  • AI Tools: Fixed problem where AI grading incorrectly included pinned/referenced content in evaluation.

  • Editor: Fixed issue preventing the "expand all descendants" command when cards are disabled.

  • iOS: Fixed app crash after enabling voice typing on iPad.

  • iOS: Fixed source uploading menu misalignment in landscape mode on iPad that prevented file uploads.

  • MCAT: Ensured all MCAT keyboard shortcuts function properly in the UI.

  • PDF Viewer: Fixed AI quiz buttons that didn't adapt to the size of the PDF reader.

  • PDF Viewer: Fixed image occlusion next button appearance in full screen mode.

  • Queue: Fixed issue where flashcard insights were not displaying correctly when disabled.

Improvements

  • Audio: Enabled audio recording feature on mobile.

  • Editor: Added keyboard arrow navigation to the link edit popup.

  • AI Summary: Restored previous scroll position when switching back to the summary tab on the AI tutor.

Bugs

  • Editor: Parsed RGB colors in the HTML parser and Markdown importer.

  • Editor: Fixed breadcrumbs jitter in toolbar.

  • Flashcards: Fixed 'X' display on multi-line card checkbox.

  • Flashcards: Fixed text input grading that was displaying encoded characters.

  • MCAT: Fixed incorrect day display showing Thursday instead of Wednesday.

  • MCAT: Fixed various issues in the MCAT interface.

  • Uploading: Fixed crash in upload popup tabs.
